Before/After Slider Maker

Upload two photos and get a standalone before/after comparison slider as an HTML file.

⬅️ Drop before image or click to browse
➡️ Drop after image or click to browse

The generated HTML is a single self-contained file — both images are embedded inside it, so it works offline. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload the before photo.
  2. Upload the after photo.
  3. Click Download HTML to save the standalone slider page.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the generated file work?

Both images are embedded as data URLs in a single self-contained HTML file with a draggable comparison slider.

Does the HTML file work offline?

Yes — it is one file with everything inside; just open it in any browser or host it anywhere.

Are my photos uploaded anywhere?

No — your images stay in your browser; only the file you download contains them.
